Interface ImageSource

All Known Subinterfaces:
ManipulatorImageSource
All Known Implementing Classes:
AbstractImageSource, AbstractManipulatorImageSource, DefaultImageSource, FilterImageSource, IiifImageSource, JxlImageSource, StackedImageSource
public interface ImageSource
A generic source for an image that can be tiled. This is analogous to the `ImageSource` trait in the Rust version.

    • crop

      BufferedImage crop(int x, int y, int width, int height, double scale) throws ImageSourceException
      Extracts a rectangular region from the image.
      Parameters:
      scale - The factor by which the cropped image should be scaled down. A scale of 1 means no scaling.

      A new BufferedImage representing the cropped region.

      ImageSourceException
